names.note: Name page 13754 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Алфей (Корбанский), диакон, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Алфея диакона». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE, and a Cyrillic grep for «Корбанский» over every `saint.json` returns nothing; the two «Алфей» folders this corpus holds are the apostle and the companion of Zacchaeus, neither of them a modern deacon.

death.note: The day line closes «(1937)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 24 июля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Алфея диакона (1937).»

attestations.note: The day's sixth entry, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind it. The line says «диакона» and name page 13754 «диакон», which agree, so `deacon` and the office `Deacon` are both the source's own words. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar's twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries, and THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. No folder held him: `ls -d saints/*korbansk*` is empty and the Cyrillic grep returns nothing. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
